title: Video
description: Poster video section with a centered heading, supporting text, and inline play control.

runtime: lazy video runtime handling data-lazyvideo and data-lazyvideo-button

aliases.purpose: Legacy names from existing projects. Agents use these only to find and map old implementations; new code must use the canonical naming fields.

projects.name: edges
projects.note: Edges uses the legacy atmosphere name and an inline video poster with data-lazyvideo.

projects.name: needles
projects.note: Needles uses the legacy atmosphere name with the same inline playback behavior.

projects.name: hvoya-cms-preview
projects.note: Hvoya maps atmosphere CMS data through section-video.blade.php.

agent.usage: Use this block when the target section is a large video/poster preview with a title, supporting text, and an inline play control that starts video playback in place. Do not use it for generic image CTAs, galleries, or modal-only video links.
transferSteps: Copy section-video.blade.php as the target section view unless the project has an explicit naming map.
Ensure required section foundation styles and the video-play-button primitive exist before adding block-specific SCSS.
Ensure the lazy video runtime is initialized when the page contains video[data-lazyvideo].
Add a video:video collection fixture or map an existing legacy videoPreview:videoPreview or atmosphere:atmosphere key through the target CMS layer.
Keep poster and video source values in CMS data; use local assets only as demo/fallback content.
acceptance: Rendered section has the canonical .video class.
Rendered target-project section uses id="video" and aria-labelledby="video-title" unless an explicit target-project anchor map overrides it.
Rendered section uses .section-header.section-header--column, .section-title, and .section-text without block-specific overrides of those primitives.
Rendered media uses video[data-lazyvideo="reset"] with poster data and an optional source[src] or source[data-src].
The play control uses .video-play-button and not .button or a block-specific CTA button class.
Clicking the play control starts inline playback only when a video source exists.
When a source exists, click adds .is-started to the media wrapper, enables native video controls, unmutes the video, and hides the play control.
When no source exists, click leaves the play control visible and does not add .is-started.
Block-specific SCSS does not target or override .section, .container, .section-header, .section-title, .section-text, or .button.
